description: DSpark verify steps of one request on one Kimi-K3 KDA layer at TP8 (snapshot spec state): rows = the verify tokens of the request (8 with the documented --speculative-dspark-block-size 7), nblocks = the AttnRes bank rows the layer reads (layer // 12 + 1: 1 on KDA layers 1-11 up to 8 on layers 85-91). The kernel has no context dependence and the model fixes every non-batch dimension, so the performance cases cover the production range under the production-range span exemption (workload_evidence.json). Derived from the serving configuration, the model's layer structure and the AgentX corpus statistics; not yet confirmed by a live capture. Rows 1 and 3 (compiled widths a DSpark-7 verify step does not use) are correctness-only.
